verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents creating private sub-teams or member-restricted groups. Client mode (per-project control over what clients see) and per-project invites are adjacent visibility controls, not sub-team creation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members

citations.quote: Basecamp’s Client mode lets you decide what they should — and shouldn’t — see, project by project.
